items.evidence: Real gains, not at par. Report _harness/_reports/fw_CW4_r3vv2_mon.json, tags fw_CW4_r3vv2_m70, _m370, _m1000 (seed 7), _m1000s11 (seed 11). MET: Longshade t=1000 dL* +26.4, hp 1.54, breakup 10.0, dE 26.7 (was -11.9, 0.66, 3.8, 8.6). Sunsplinter t=370 hp 3.23, dL* 33.7, breakup 30.6 (was hp 2.6); the core is a painted dial with an hour ring. Stilltusk hp 1.58 / 1.70, dL* 28.5 / 20.1. At t=1000 no single run held both Resinback and a Stilltusk kind, so I compared their stored silhouettes across seeds 7 and 11: 0.44 and 0.43. That also fills the young t=1000 gap the engineer left, by a cross-run method. NOT MET: cross-camp IoU over 0.5 is worse than claimed. t=1000 seed 7: resinback|gloamoth_little 0.68 (claimed 0.61), resinback|gloamoth 0.66 (claimed 0.52), stray_numeral|gloamoth_little 0.60 (claimed 0.53), stray_tick|gloamoth 0.58, stray_tick|gloamoth_little 0.57, stray_numeral|gloamoth 0.56, stray_tick|resinback 0.51. t=70: gloamoth and gloamoth_little|stray_numeral 0.53. t=370: stray_numeral|gloamoth_little 0.54, stray_numeral|gloamoth 0.52. The moth values move with wing phase. By eye these kinds are never confused (colour and shape differ), so the risk is low, but the <= 0.5 gate is unmet. stray_tick dL* 12.0 / 12.7 / 19.9 (engineer 12.0 / 17 / 21.4): well under 20 in wall shadow; 12.7 at t=370 is more than the 2 L* tolerance. stray_numeral 19.6-19.7 is inside tolerance. MY RE-SCORE by eye and metrics: row 6.8, under the 7.5 par bar (engineer self-score 7.0). Units: gloamoth 7.5; glasshorn, gloamoth_little, resinback, stilltusk, stilltusk_young, stray_numeral, sunsplinter 7.0; stray_tick 6.5; longshade 6.0. Longshade weighs most as the epic: it now reads, but as a bare lavender crawler with smooth bubble clusters and plain limbs, not as smoke or shade (_harness/_shots/value_rift_high_fw_CW4_r3vv2_m1000_mon_longshade.png). Sensitivity by eye on my live frames of glasshorn, gloamoth and little, resinback, stilltusk and young, stray_numeral, stray_tick, sunsplinter, longshade: no blocker. Longshade plate and lamp eyes are covered by ruling 1, but see the minor below.
